title: Maple-Ginger Chicken Thighs
description: This recipe features chicken thighs baked in a ginger-maple sauce made with maple syrup, soy sauce, garlic oil, ginger powder, sesame seeds, and cayenne.
authors: Im Not a Chef I just Cook alot
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil, or to taste
2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a baking dish with olive oil.
Combine maple syrup, soy sauce, garlic oil, ginger powder, sesame seeds, black pepper, and cayenne pepper in a bowl.
Arrange chicken thighs in the prepared baking dish; pour maple sauce over top. Turn thighs in sauce using tongs or gloved hands until fully coated. Cover dish with aluminum foil.

Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes. Uncover dish; flip thighs. Continue baking, uncovered, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into centers reads 200 degrees F (93 degrees C), about 15 minutes. Flip thighs again; sprinkle with parsley. Rest before serving, 10 minutes.
